data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Shelf Turns, Expanse Burns as Latch Sees Action
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Three hours on have redrawn the ledger on the 206th day of the campaign, with most districts reporting no change while a handful carry the fighting. The Weathered Expanse now stands seven Colonial towns to two Warden against the earlier count, with 52 changes in the day and eight in the last two hours about Shattered Advance, Wightwalk and Frostmarch, and 8,175 Colonial and 9,785 Warden casualties in 24 hours. Stlican Shelf shows the sharpest turn, now six Colonial to three Warden with 46 changes and eleven in two hours at Breaker Town and The Pale House. Callahan's Passage lists nine Warden to one Colonial with no destroyed posts and 16 changes, all at The Latch. Linn Mercy holds eight Colonial to three Warden with 19 changes and six in two hours at The Long Whine. Marban Hollow and Viper Pit remain lively with fresh flips within the hour at Mox and Blackthroat, while Dead Lands, though still wholly Colonial with 16 changes, Godcrofts with 21, and Stonecradle with 14 have recorded nothing in the last two hours.
